selection: Use original one-based iResp in its stored order; experimental column 2 only. No additional selection or exclusion based on response values.
aggregation: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of the 103 selected ROI response vectors independently for each original polarity; mirrors the mathematical operation in pinned shortFlashProcessed_saveMean.m, without executing author code.
comparison: Compare original unnormalized raw fluorescence means and original time vector, with no sign inversion, rescaling, smoothing, shifts, fitting, row permutation or parameter search.
hypothesis: Test whether the unmodified source-selected mean reproduces the deposited highLum aggregate; also report the separately named lowLum comparison without selecting a preferred transform or using it as biological validation.
failure_policy: Preserve mismatches and invalid inputs; do not adjust selection, tolerance or transformation to force agreement.
exports: Hashes, membership counts, dimensions, finite checks, maximum/mean absolute differences, comparison status and resource records. Do not export individual response values or aggregate response arrays in tracked artifacts.
data_exposure: This check reads all source-selected response vectors to validate their aggregation. It is not a fit or biological holdout evaluation. Later assessment must disclose this source-validation exposure and prior published model/aggregate use of the data.
limitations: Numerical agreement links processed data products under the declared averaging operation. It does not validate microscopy preprocessing, absolute illumination, voltage or release units, population representativeness, MaleCNS transfer, whole-CNS vision or gameplay learning. Dryad CC0 does not establish licensing for the separate GitHub aggregates.
